tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ chos thams cad kyi snying po phyag rgya chen po'i don yang dag pa rab tu gsal bar byed pa dri ma med pa'i sgron ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 400)na mo ma hā mu dra ye/ gdod ma nyid nas yongs dag pa'i// gnas lugs spros mtshan kun gyis dben// chos nyid 'od gsal ye shes mchog /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyag gis mchod// gshis ngor gang yang grub min kyang*// snang char sna tshogs shar ba'i 'phrul// dbyer med gnyug ma'i rang 'gros nyid// rang ngo sprod phyir 'dir bshad bya/ de yang rgyal ba'i bka' rab 'byams mtha' yas pa kun gyis dgongs pa'i snying po ni 'gro ba'i khams la de 401)bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi snying po gnas pa de nyid mngon gyur du bya ba'i slad du chos kyi rnam grangs sam theg pa'i bye brag mtha' yas par bstan mod kyi/ gdul bya'i mos pa dang bskal pa tha dad pa de dang de dag la 'dul byed kyi chos sgo dang gdams pa'i rnam grangs kyang de snyed du 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje'i phrin las kyi mthu stobs khyad par smad du byung ba nyid yin pa dang*/ de dag las mchog tu gyur pa'i nye lam 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa kun gyi rtse mo'i don mthar thug 402)pa/ sems nyid sku gsum lhun grub kyi rang zhal mngon sum bde blag tu ston par byed pa'i thabs mchog grub mchog rig 'dzin kun gyis bgrod pa gcig pa'i gzhung lam phyag rgya chen po zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di nyid dgongs don nye bar 'kho ba'i gnad 'dus cung zad bstan par bya ste/ 'di la'ang don tshan rnam pa gsum gyis ston pa las/ 1 gsum gang zhe na/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs 'khrul grol gnyis kyi sgo nas lta ba'i don mdor bstan pa dang*/ lam phyag rgya chen po rang byung rang babs zhi lhag gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams len pa lam ji ltar bgrod tshul rgyas par bshad pa dang*/

2 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po dri bral don gyi sangs rgyas sku gsum mngon du gyur pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul bshad pas 'gags bsdu ba dang gsum gyis ston pa'i 403)dang po ni/ de yang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang du'ang ma grub cing phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i rang ngo la bde sdug yin min yod med rtag chad bdag gzhan la sogs pa'i ming 'dogs kyi tha snyad gang gis kyang ma gos shing bslad pas sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba/ ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i gnad kyis/ rnam pa'am mtshan nyid cir yang 'char ba'i gzhir rung la/ gang ltar shar yang don la bden par ma grub pa ste/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i stong pa chen po 'dus ma byas pa'i chos kyi dbyings de nyid sku gsum lhun grub kyi rang bzhin nyid du ye nas yin pa de la/ gzhi dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po cazhas bya ba ste/ ༈ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud las/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid 'di// chos rnams 404)kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ ces gsungs pa/ de ni gang zag gcig tsam mam/ sangs rgyas gcig tsam gyi thugs rgyud la yod pa lta bu ni min te/ snang srid 'khor 'das mtha' dag gi dngos gzhir khyab pa yin zhing*/ 'di'i gnas tshul lam yin tshul rtogs shing rig pa na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dang*/ der ma rtogs ma rig cing 'khrul pa shar ba la sems can ces bya ba ste 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i gzhi byed pa'i phyir des na 'khor 'das kyi spyi gzhi zhes su grags pa ste/ bram ze chen po sa ra has/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// gang las srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ngo bo gcig la snang tshul tha dad dam/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par tsam la rnam pa so sor snang mod kyi/ de 405)gnyis gang gi tshe na'ang rang gi ngo bo la bzang ngan dang 'pho 'gyur sogs kyi skyon gyis ma gos par gdod nas sku gsum dbyer med chen por gnas pa 'di la/

thun mong theg pa'i skabs rnams su ni 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub ces kyang bya ste/ thog ma'i gzhi'i gnas lugs yin no/ de lta bu'i gnas tshul de la rtogs ma rtogs gnyis ka ma yin pa'i btang snyoms lung ma bstan du gnas pa de la kun gzhi zhes bya ba ste/ 'khor 'das gnyis ka'i gzhi byed pa'i phyir ro/ kun gzhi de nyid kyang ci yang med pa'i stong pa phyang chad ma yin par rang gsal gyi shes pa 'gag med 'char rung du yod pa de la kun gzhi'i rnam shes ces bya ba ste/ me long dang de'i dwangs cha lta bu'o/ kun gzhi gcig pu de las 406)'khor 'das so sor gyes tshul ni/ rang gsal gyi shes pa de'i rig cha'am ye shes kyi cha ngo bo stong zhing rang bzhin gsal la dbyer med rig pa'i snying po de ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang yang dag pa'i lam gyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon dang rgyu nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba don gyi kun gzhi yang zer/ bde gshegs snying po/ rang rig chos sku shes rab phar phyin/ rang sems sangs rgyas la sogs mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs las btags pa'i ming thams cad 'dir mthun cing*/ lam la zhugs pa rnams kyis mngon du bya rgyu dang rang ngo sprod rgyu yang 'di yin no/ yang*/ kun gzhi lung ma bstan de'i gti mug gi cha las rang ngo rang gi ma rig cing gnas lugs ma rtogs par rang gis rang nyid bsgribs pa de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zhes kyang bya/ thog med dus kyi mun chen 407)zhes kyang bya ste/ 'di la brten nas nyon mongs dang 'khrul rtog mtha' dag 'byung phyir bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi zhes kyang bya ba/ sems can thams cad kyi 'khrul gzhi yin no/ de yang dgongs pa zang thal gyi rgyud las/ gzhi las rig pa ma shar bas// ci yang dran med thom me ba// de ka ma rig 'khrul pa'i rgyu/ zhes gsungs shing*/ ma rig pa 'di'i 'khor gyi tshul du chags pa bar ma dang*/

brjed nges la sogs gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun yang yod do/ de lta bu'i lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa de las nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa shar/ bdag la brten nas gzhan du bzung ba byung zhing*/ rang snang la rang snang du ma shes par phyi'i yul du bzung ste/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa ngo ma shes pas 'khrul pa'i 'go rtsom/ de la kun tu btags pa'i ma rig 408)pa zer/ yid kyi rnam shes kyang zer te/ yul sems tha dad du 'khrul pa'i sems yin la/ 'di'i 'khor du chags dang zhen pa la sogs 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu rnams yod do/ de nas yid kyi rnam shes de'i rtsal las bag chags 'khrul pa sna tshogs pa shar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ de'i grogs su las rlung khyab byed kyi rkyen dang*/ kun gzhi ma rig pa'i rgyu sogs rten cing 'brel 'byung gi mthu brtas pa'i dbang gis lus snang sems gsum tshang bar grub cing*/ sgo lnga'i dbang shes kyi bye brag dang tshogs drug gi snang rtog shar ba la gzhan dbang zhes kyang bya/ rtsa ba'i rlung chen lnga dang yan lag gi rlung phran lnga sogs kyi rnam rtog gi bzhon pa byas shing rang snang 'khrul 'dzin goms pa'i mthu las grub pa'i snod bcud du snang bas gzhi rten dang yul du byas nas mtha' dag bskyed pa'i phyir na nyon mongs 409)pa can gyi yid kyang zer/ dbang po sgo lnga so sor rgyu zhing zhen chags sogs kyi byed po yin phyir sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa yang zer la/ 'di'i 'khor du chags bral bar ma la sogs zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog tshogs sum cu rtsa gsum yang yod do/ de ltar rtsa ba bag chags sna tshogs pa'i kun gzhi dang*/ yan lag rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog rim gyis mched cing 'khrul pa lu gu rgyud du gyur pas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'khyams pa 'di ni ma rtogs sems can gyi 'khrul tshul yin la/ kun gzhi la 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi bag chags sa bon gyi tshul du gnas pa'i mthus/

nang gi lus brdos bcas rags pa dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le dwangs snyigs sna tshogs pa'i dngos po dang*/ phyi rol tu 'khor 'das khams gsum snod bcud kyi dngos po thams cad gcig la gcig brten gyi tshul du snang ba 'di dag kyang*/ 410)don la med bzhin kun rdzob tu snang ba'i cho 'phrul rmi lam gyi yul snang lta bu 'di la rtag 'dzin a 'thas bden zhen la ches cher goms pas khams gsum rigs drug gi bde sdug btang snyoms sna tshogs la spyod cing*/ 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras zo chu'i 'khyud mo lta bu la rtag tu 'khor ba ni sems can spyi'i mtshan nyid lags mod kyi/ de ltar 'khrul zhing 'khor bar 'khyams dus kyang khams bde gshegs snying po'am rig pa'i ngo bo la ni ngan du song ba'i 'grib par 'gyur ba ni rdul tsam yang med de/ rtag gnyis kyi rgyud las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs/ ces gsungs la/ don dam par ni ye gdod ma'i gnas lugs kyang sku gsum dbyer med du lham me/ bar du 'khrul snang blo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs dus kyang gshis kyi rang ngo sku gsum du lhang nge*/ mthar sgrib byed sangs nas 411)mkhyen gnyis rgyas pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur dus kyang sku gsum du lhan ner bzhugs pa nyid/ de'i phyir na 'khrul rtog ma rig pa'i dri ma dang ma bral tsam la 'khrul grol gnyis su tha snyad btags pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ zhes so/ de bas na sems nyid gdod nas dag pa'i ngo bor lhun gyis grub kyang blo bur gyi 'khrul pa'am lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa ni gser la g.ya' skyes pa bzhin rang las byung bas rang nyid bsgribs pa 'di sbyong zhing dag par byed pa'i thabs kyi bye brag sna tshogs gsungs la/ ngo bo dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i rang byung ye shes mtshan ma'i spros pas dben pa nyid shes rab kyi cha dngos yin phyir/

des na lam thams cad thabs shes gnyis su 'du ba ni rgyal ba'i dgongs 412)don mthar thug pa'o/ ci 'o na sngar bshad pa'i kun gzhi gcig pu las 'khor 'das gnyis su gyes pa mi 'thad dam snyam na de ni dper na sman ga pur gcig gis nad tsha grang so so la phan gnod tha dad byed pa dang*/ dug gi dngos po gcig la sngags sogs thabs kyis zin na sman du 'gyur la/ thabs dang bral bas zos na 'chi bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ 'dir yang kun gzhi'i ngo bo gcig la rig cing rang ngo shes na grol ba dang*/ ma rig cing bdag tu bzung na 'khrul ba ste/ rtogs ma rtogs kho nas kha bsgyur ba nyid/ 'phags pa klu grub kyis/ nyon mongs drwa bas g.yogs pa na// sems can zhes ni brjod par byed// de nyid nyon mongs bral gyur na// sangs rgyas zhes ni brjod pa'o/ zhes so/ de ltar na chos kun snying po nges don phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa'i thabs kyis zin na 413)gzhi phyag rgya chen po gnas lugs kyi rang sa zin/ lam phyag rgya chen pos 'khrul rtog gi dri ma sbyang*/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po sku gsum gyi rgyal sa zin te don gnyis kyi gter kha phye ba'i phyir/ skal ldan snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis byin rlabs bcud dang ldan pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid tshang ba btsal la/ nor bzang dang rtag tu ngu'i lo rgyus sam/ te lo pa dang nā ro zhabs kyi rnam thar lta bus bsten cing*/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi 'jug sgo'i gtso bo smin byed kyi rim pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas rgyud smin nges su bya ba dang*/ grol byed kyi gdams pa'i sna khrid la mchog tu gces pa thun mong dang khyad par gyi sngon 'gro mtha' dag sla chos dang sgyid snyoms khyad sod du ma song bar re re nas rtags 'thon du 'bad pa dang*/ khyad par du yang bla ma la mos 414)gus kyi rnal 'byor la kha zhe med pa'i nyams len rtsal 'don du byas te byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'babs nges su byed pa ni/

bka' rgyud rig 'dzin grub thob kun gyi phyag bzhes snying po dam pa'o/ de yang*/ zhi byed chu klung chen po'i rgyud las/ brjod bral lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'di// tshogs bsags sgrib pa dag pa'i lag rjes dang*// rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las// thabs gzhan bsten na rmongs par shes par bya/ zhes so/ de nas dngos gzhi nyid la'ang rgyud pa so so'i phyag srol gyi babs las/ lta thog nas sgom pa ngos bzung ba dang*/ sgom thog nas lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa sogs khrid tshul gang byed kyang*/ gtso bor bla ma rgyud pa'i byin rlabs zhugs pa zhig kho na gal che zhing*/ lta ba dngos ni/ spyir theg pa'i bye brag dang grub mtha'i 415)rnam grangs tha dad la lta ba'i bzhed tshul bsam gyis mi khyab kyang*/ rang rang gi ngo bor ni de dang de dag bden par gzhi grub cing*/ theg pa mtha' dag rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi sgo rab 'byams mtha' yas pa'i bkod pa yin phyir dag dang ma dag bzang ngan la sogs su bdag ni mi smra zhing kun la rjes su yi rang la/ skabs 'di'i lta ba de ni/ sems nyid ye gdod ma nas yongs dag chen por lhun gyis grub cing 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du skye 'gag gnas dang 'gro 'ong gi spros pa dang bral ba/ 'khor 'das lam gsum du 'dzin pa'i dmigs mtshan gyis ma bslad pa/ yod med yin min rtag chad bzang ngan mtho dman la sogs kyi sgro skur ma byas pa/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i snang srid kyi chos thams cad la dgag sgrub spong len bsgyur bkod ma byas pa'i 416)ye nas gnas tshul lam yin tshul ji lta ba'i rang bzhin snang stong dbyer med du khrig ge gsal stong zung 'jug tu lam me/ ye grol khyab gdal du shig ge/ 'dus ma byas lhun grub tu cham me ba 'di ni lta ba'i dngos gzhi yin lugs ji bzhin du gdod ma nas rang byung la de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi ngo bor ye khyab tu gyur pa 'di las gzhan pa'i lta ba zhes khol bu'am dum bur ris su chad pa zhig med/

de lta bu ye nas yin tshul shes pas gnyis 'dzin gyi brdzun mtshang rig pa la lta ba rtogs pa yang zer/ sems ngo mthong ba yang zer/ chos don rig pa yang zer te/ do ha mdzod las/ rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang shes mi 'gyur/ ces gsungs/ don la snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad sku gsum gyi rol pa yin pa dang*/ rang gi sems nyid kyang sku gsum gyi rang 417)bzhin nyid dang*/ de dag nyid kyang don dam chos nyid kyi dbyings las 'da' ba med cing*/ de yang 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ni sems kyi mtshan nyid kyi tshul dang*/ lam gyi chos thams cad chos kyi yon tan gyi tshul dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos thams cad sems kyi nus pa'i tshul du tshang ba ste/ sems nyid kho rang gi gshis skye med chos sku/ gdangs 'gags med longs sku/ rtsal cir yang 'char ba sprul sku/ de gsum yang ngo bo dbyer med du lhun gyis grub cing*/ de ltar yin lugs rang ngo shes shing thag chod pa ni lta ba skyon med phyin ci ma log pa yang dag par rtogs pa zhes bya la/ 'di las gzhan pa'i lta ba mtha' dang bral ma bral mtho khyad bzang ngan la sogs dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma dang blos byas yid dpyod kyi rtog pas btags pa'i lta sgom gang yang phyag rgya chen po'i lta bar ma gsungs so// 418)gnyis pa lam gyi phyag rgya chen po'i sgom pa zhi lhag dang*/ skyon yon mnyam rjes rnal 'byor sa lam bgrod tshul sogs bstan pa ni/ de yang spyir sgom pa zhes pa'i ming 'jug pa ni mang la/ grub mtha' so so la rang skabs kyi bsgom tshul yang mtha' yas na'ang*/ 'dir ni sngar bshad ma thag pa'i lta ba gnas lugs kyi don de rgyud la goms 'dris su bya ba la sgom pa'i ming dang tha snyad du btags pa tsam ma gtogs/ dngos po kha dog dbyibs can lta bu blos bcos nas bsgom pa'am/ sems kyi 'gyu dran 'char snang bkag pa'i bcos ma'i stong nyid lta bu zhig ched du bsgom pa ni gtan nas ma yin te/

rang sems kyi babs bzo med du skyong ba kho na yin la/ bre brag tu gang zag gi dbang po dang blo rigs sna tshogs pa'i phyir/ cig char dbang po rnon po sbyangs pa mngon gyur dag la ni 419)zhi lhag rim can du dkri mi dgos par ngo 'phrod pa dang grol ba dus mnyam du 'gyur ba dag 'byung mod na'ang*/ gzhan phal pa dag la ni rim gyis khrid dgos phyir thog mar zhi gnas kyi rim pa mtshan bcas shing bu rde'u lha sku yig 'bru thig rlung gi sbyor ba sogs la bslab cing*/ de dag la nges pa rnyed nas slar mtshan med mchog gi zhi gnas la 'jug par bya ste/ zhi gnas dngos ni mnyam par bzhag thabs gsum gyi sgo nas ston te/ de yang phyi nang gi yul rkyen gyi rjes su sems yengs pa ma yin par yengs med so mar bzhag pa dang*/ sgo gsum ha cang bsgrims pas bcings pa ma yin par rtsol med rang babs lhug par bzhag pa dang*/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo dang dran rig gnyis ya bral tha dad gnyen po bsten pa lta bu ma yin par 420)rang rig rang gsal rang dwangs su bzhag pa ste/ 'di gsum la ming gi rnam grangs gzhan du/ ma yengs/ mi bsgom/ bzo med ces kyang bya la/ thun mong gi theg par gsungs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum yang 'dir tshang ste/ sems de ka sngar 'das pa'i bya byed sogs la 'di byas 'di byung gi rjes gcod mi bya ba ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa ces bya ba dang*/ de lta'i sems la blos byas kyi bsgyur bkod dang 'di snang 'di bya'i dgag sgrub med pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ ma 'ongs par 'di dang 'di bzhin 'byung 'gyur gyi sngun bsu dang*/ sgom yong du re ba dang mi yong gi dogs pa lta bu'i 'dod 'dun med pa ni rnam par thar pa smon pa med pa'i sgo zhes bya zhing*/ mdor bsdu na/ rang sems rang babs bcos bslad med par 'jog pa nyid la 'dus so/ 421)de'i ngang nas rnam par rtog pa gcig khyugs kyi shar ba'i tshe na/

gang shar ba de la rjes 'thud du ma song bar rang ngo hrig gis shes par bya ba kho nas chog gi ched du bkag pa'am/ sgom la tshur bkug pa'am/ gnyen po gzhan gyis gcun pa sogs gang yang mi bya ste/ de dag gang byas kyang sems nyid ma bcos bzo med skyong ba'i gnad ma yin cing*/ lam gyi bye brag gzhan las sna tshogs 'byung mod kyang*/ 'di skabs su ni gang shar rang ngo shes pa'i lam kho na yin pas thabs gzhan btsal na phyag rgya chen po'i sgom du mi 'gyur te/ de yang bram ze chen pos/ 'gro rnams bsam gtan rtsol bas bslad// sgom rgyu ci yang med pa la// yengs su skad cig mi 'dod pas// phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yin/ 422)ces gsungs shing*/ de ltar sems kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i thog tu mnyam par gzhag pas/ zhi gnas kyi nyams gsum po rim can du 'char bar 'gyur te/ gang zhe na/ dang por sems cher rgod cing 'phro ba'i rtog pa sngar las kyang mang du song ba lta bu'i bar mtshams 'gar cung zad tsam re gnas pa zhig 'byung ba'i 'phro ba de la skyon du mi blta ste/ sngon chad 'phro ba sha stag yin kyang ngos ma zin pa de 'di skabs 'phro gnas kyi dbye ba shes pa yin tshe/ zhi gnas dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu zhes bya/ de ltar bskyangs pas rnam rtog phal cher mgo non te 'jam nyal gyi 'gro zhing lus sems bde 'bol gyi song bas bya byed gzhan la zhen pa mi 'jug par mnyam bzhag la spro zhing*/ thengs re tsam las gzhan rtog pa'i 'gyu 'phro med pa'i gnas pa shas cher 423)gyur pa ni/ zhi gnas bar ma chu bo dal 'bab lta bu dang*/ slar yang rnam g.yeng med par brtson pas nyams su blangs na/ lus kyi tshor ba'i zug rngu gang yang med par bde cham me/ sems gsal dwangs rtog pa med par nyin mtshan 'das pa mi tshor zhing ji tsam mnyam par gzhag gi bar du g.yo ba med cing rkyen gyis mi gnod la/ nyon mongs mngon gyur zhi zhing zas gos sogs kyi zhen pa cher mi 'byung ba dang*/

zag bcas kyi mngon shes dang gsal snang gi nyams kyi bye brag sna tshogs 'char ba sogs thun mong gi yon tan ltar snang ba du ma 'byung ba ni zhi gnas mthar thug rgya mtsho mi g.yo ba lta bu zhes bya zhing*/ 'di skabs su bla ma nyams myong can dang ma phrad cing snying rus che la thos pa chung ba'i sgom chen pa mang po yon tan ltar 424)snang ba la rlom sems skyes shing*/ skye bo dag gis kyang grub thob tu mthong ba la brten nas rang gzhan mang po phung nyen yod pas gzab 'tshal lo/ de ltar zhi gnas kyi sgom rkyang pas ni/ phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len dngos gzhir rung ba ma yin kyang gzhi rten gyi tshul du nges par gal che bar gsungs shing*/ de yang*/ rgyal ba lo ras kyis/ gsal cha med pa'i zhi gnas lteng po// bsgom yun ring yang don mi rtogs kyi// lta stangs rig pa'i ngar dang ldan pas// thun chung 'phro la 'thud cing bsgom zhig ces gsungs so/ dngos gzhi lhag mthong ni/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo la dbyibs kha dog sogs mtshan ma dngos can du grub ma grub dang*/ byung gnas 'gro gsum/ skye 'gags yod med/ rtag chad mtha' dbus la sogs kyi brdar sha'i the tshom phu thag ma 425)chod na lta ba yin lugs kyi thog tu mi phebs/ de ma phebs na sgom rang babs rang 'gros kyi skyong tshul mi shes/ de ma shes tshe zhi gnas blun rmongs dang sdug btsir sems 'dzin gyi snying rus ji tsam byas kyang khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras las ma 'das tshe/ des na bla ma mtshan ldan gyi drung du sgro 'dogs gcod cing*/ khyad par gsang sngags byin rlabs kyi lam pa yin phyir mos gus gsol 'debs la 'bad pas brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyi rtogs pa 'pho thabs la 'bungs/ de ltar byas tshe rang gi rig pa ye gdod ma nas chos sku'i ngo bor lhun grub tu yod pa'i tshul sngar lta ba'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin/ mngon sum rtog bral gyi ye shes yod med yin min rtag chad gang gi yang mthar ma lhungs shing*/

gsal rig stong gsal dbyer med du myong zhing shes 426)kyang dpes mtshon du med la tshig gis brjod thabs zad pa/ rang byung rang gsal du hrig ge ba 'di la lhag mthong zhes ming du btags mod kyi/ 'di nyid dang po so so skye bo'i dus nas rang dang 'du 'bral skad cig tsam med kyang gdams ngag dang byin rlabs kyis ma zin pas ngo ma shes/ bar du zhi gnas la mnyam par gzhag mkhan nam/ gnas mi gnas blta mkhan sogs thams cad kho rang yin kyang rang gis rang ma mthong ba lta bur gyur pa ste/ tha mal pa'i dus kyi rnam rtog lu gu rgyud du 'phro ba de nyid lhag mthong kho rang rnam rtog tu snang ba las gzhan min la/ zhi gnas kyi nyams dang bde gsal mi rtog de thams cad lhag mthong gi rig pa kho rang dag tu shar ba las gzhan min yang*/ blo bral rjen pa'i rang ngo ma rig na gnas cha rkyang par song nas byang chub kyi rgyu ru 427)mi 'gro ba yin zhing*/ rang ngo mthong phyin chad ni gnas 'phro gang yang lhag mthong ngam phyag rgya chen por ma gyur pa ci yang med/ lo ras kyis/ tshogs drug yul du cir shar yang*// yid kyi 'dzin pa ma zhugs na// thams cad rang snang rang grol yin// dbyer med rtogs sam sgom chen kun/ ces gsungs so/ de yang spyi ltar na/ rnam rtog rang sar zhi nas sems bde gsal mi rtog gi ngang du gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ sems kyi ngo bo rang gsal yul med sgro skur dang bral ba rjen ne lhang nger mthong ba ni lhag mthong*/ zhes pa dang*/ yang rnam rtog 'phro 'du bral ba zhi gnas/ 'gyu ba rang ngo shes pa lhag mthong*/ zhes sogs mang yang don la ni gang snang cir shar thams cad zhi lhag dbyer med kho na las ma 'das te/ gnas pa dang 'gyu ba ni sems kho rang gcig pu'i 428)rol pa las ma 'das pas/ de gnyis gang gi tshe yang rang ngo shes na lhag mthong gi rang bzhin nyid dang*/ phyi rol tshogs drug gi snang ba gang la yang a 'thas kyi zhen pa ma zhugs pa ni zhi gnas/

'char sgo 'gags med du snang ba lhag mthong ste/ snang thog tu zhi lhag zung 'jug tshang*/ rnam rtog lhangs kyi shar tshe rang ngo hrig gis shes par byed pa zhi gnas/ de nyid rang sems blo bral rjen par grol ba lhag mthong ste/ rtog thog na yang zhi lhag zung 'jug yang*/ nyon mongs pa shin tu drag po zhig skyes pa'i tshe na'ang de'i rjes su a 'thas su ma song ba rang ngo la blta ba ni zhi gnas/ blta mkhan gyi rig pa dang blta ba'i nyon mongs so sor ma grub pa'i gsal stong rjen pa ni lhag mthong ste/ nyon mongs kyi thog tu yang zhi lhag zung 'jug tshang ste/ mdor na sems nyid rang gi ngo bo 429)la ni gnas 'gyu 'phro 'du bzang ngan du grub pa med cing*/ de dag tu snang ba rnams ni rol rtsal las 'gag med kyi 'char tshul tsam yin tshe/ zhi gnas lhag mthong kyang de bzhin du dbyer med zung 'jug kho na grub kyang*/ rnam pa ltar gang zag gis 'jug pa bde ba'i slad du ming dang dbye ba so sor bstan la/ gong du zhi gnas rkyang pas phyag chen gyi sgom dngos gzhi ru go mi chod par bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ gnas cha gcig pu ni 'jig rten gyi bsam gtan zhes phyi rol mu stegs pa dang nang pa'i yang nyan rang gi bsam gtan dag dang*/ lha gnas rnams kyi ting 'dzin dang thun mong ba yin phyir/ sngags kyi dbang bzhi pa'i lam dngos ma yin pa dang*/ khyad par gnas nyams la zhen 'dzin yod pa ni phyag rgya chen por mi rung la/ phyag chen ni snang srid chos 430)sku lam byed gyi skabs yin tshe/ gnas pa dang 'gyu ba gnyis la bzang ngan dang sgom yin min gyi spang blang byed na snang srid chos sku/ cir snang phyag chen/ gang shar bzo med du mi rung bas so/ de ltar zhi lhag gi don mdo tsam smos nas/ da ni skyon yon dang gol sa'i bye brag cung zad 'chad de/ 'di la'ang spyir mnyam bzhag skyong tshul ma shes pa'i nor sa dang*/ bye brag tu gol sa dang shor sa'i rnam grangs skyon sel bshad pa dang gnyis kyi/

dang po ni/ de yang phyag rdzogs lam gcod zhi byed sogs sgom gyi man ngag zab rgyas mtha' yas pa kun gyi dgongs pa'i gnad gcig tu mthun par rang sems ma bcos par 'jog pa nyid lags kyang*/ gang zag so so'i go tshul gyi dbang gis sna tshogs zhig snang mod de/ de las sgom chen pa 'ga' zhig ni/ tshogs drug gi snang ba phra rags thams cad 431)'gags pa'i shes pa rtog med kho na la sgom du 'dzin par gda' ste/ de ni zhi gnas lteng por gol ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig ni dran rig gis ma zin pa'i gti mug lung ma bstan la sgom brtan po ru rlom/ la las ni sems gsal seng nge ba dang*/ bde lhan ne ba dang*/ stong cham me ba sogs la sgom du 'dzin te nyams la zhen/ la las rtog pa snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma skyes pa'i bar gyi shes pa had po kho na dgos par 'dod de sgom dum bu ru chad/ yang la las ni sems nyid chos sku yin no/ stong pa yin/ ngos bzung med do/ snyam pa sogs yid la bcangs pa dang*/ de bzhin du thams cad bden par ma grub pa'o/ sgyu ma lta bu'o/ nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam pa la sogs pa'i 'dzin stangs la sgom du 'dod pa ni blos byas yid dpyod kyi mthar lhungs/ 432)'ga' zhig ni/ gang dran cir shar thams cad sgom gyi rang bzhin yin zer nas/ rnam rtog tha mal ba'i dbang du btang bas smyon par gol/ gzhan dag phal cher ni 'gyu ba la skyon du blta zhing dgag pa dang*/ 'gyus pa de tshur bkug nas sgom la 'jog par 'dod cing*/ 'jur dran dam pos sdug 'tshir du 'ching bar byed pa sogs te/ mdor na sems nyid 'di gnas sam/ 'gyu'am/ rnam rtog dang nyon mongs su kar re 'dug gam/ bde gsal mi rtog gang rung du lhan ner 'dug gam/ gang ltar snang kyang de ka'i rang thog tu bzo bcos spong bsgyur mi dgos par gnyug ma lhan skyes kyi rang 'gros skyong shes pa ni shin tu dkon par mchis tshe nges don gyi mdo rgyud dang*/

grub thob brgyud pa'i bka' 'bum man ngag khrid yig sogs kyi dgongs pa dngos bstan dang mthun pa'i nyams 433)len skyon med zhig dgos par snang ngi/ bye brag gi gol sa dang shor sa'i dbye ba ni sgrub rgyud gong ma rnams kyi gsung las zhib rgyas 'byung mod kyi/ 'dir yang rkang grangs brda tshon tsam bshad na/ de yang mnyam bzhag gi skabs su bde gsal mi rtog gsum gang rung gi nyams la zhen na/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med kyi khams dang gsum du skye ba'i rgyu byed la/ de dag tu skyes nas tshe tshad rdzogs pa dang slar ngan song du lhung ba las sangs rgyas kyi lam du mi 'gyur zhing*/ de tshul zhib tu dbye na/ bye brag tu snyoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dgu yod de/ de yang zhi gnas la mnyam par bzhag tshe/ gzung 'dzin rag rtogs med kyang bsgom bya sgom byed kyi blos bcings ba ni bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ste/ 434)ci'i phyir na/ bsam gtan dang po'i lha gnas rnams na de ltar bsgom pa yin tshe/ de lta yang de bzhin bsgom na bsam gtan dang po pa'i lha ru skye ba'i rgyu byed do/ de bzhin du/ rtog dpyod kyi shes pa med kyang dga' bde'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ro myang bar byed pa ni bsam gtan gnyis pa/ sems g.yo ba med cing dbugs kyi 'byung rngub tsam la brten pa ni bsam gtan gsum pa/ rnam rtog thams cad dang bral la gsal ba'i go ma 'gags pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni bsam gtan bzhi pa ste/ de ltar 'di dag ni 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas ni mchog tu grags shing lhag mthong gi gzhi rten yin yang*/ zhen pas bsgoms na phyag chen gyi gol sar 'gyur te bsam gtan gyi lha de dag tu skye ba'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ yang*/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtha' 435)yas so snyam pa dang*/ rnam par shes pa 'di ni phyogs su ma lhung ma grub cing mtha' yas pa'o snyam pa dang*/

'du shes ni med pa dang yod pa ma yin te blos byar med do snyam pa dang*/ sems 'di ni ci yang med pa'i stong pa'o snyam pa ste/ de ltar rim pa bzhi po 'di'i ngang la 'jog na/ nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ yod min med min/ ci yang med pa ste/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gol ba'i skyon can no/ de thams cad kyi rtog pa spangs ba'i sems nyid yul la 'jug pa bkag cing rlung sems rgyu ba chad par gnas pa ni nyan thos zhi ba'i ting 'dzin yin te/ 'di zhi gnas kyi mthar thug tu bshad kyang lhag mthong gis zin tshe/ 'di skabs kyi sgom skyon med ni ma yin no/ de ltar snyoms 'jug 436)gi bsam gtan dgu po dag so sos gnas skabs su mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs 'grub pa'i yon tan tsam yod kyang*/ 'dir ni mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdzogs byang nyid bsgrub pa las/ kun rdzob ltar snang gi yon tan mi bsgrub cing*/ gal te shugs kyis 'grub kyang de la zhen pa dang rlom sems skyes na byang chub kyi bar chad dngos yin pa'i tshul rnams shes dgos so// de ltar nor sa'am gol sa bshad nas/ da ni shor sa brgyad kyi rnam grangs ston te/ de yang sems nyid rnam kun mchog ldan snang stong zung 'jug rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'gags med du ma rtogs par/ stong pa kha lta la 'byams pa ni stong nyid gshis la ye shor du song zhes bya ba yin pas/ de'i skyon rig par bya zhing*/ de bzhin du/ sgom la bzhugs nas don yin tshul tsam go yang*/ nyams myong rgyud la ma skyes shing 437)skyes pa dag kyang brjed de/ gzhan la tshig 'chad shes kyang don rang gi rgyud la med pa de la gshis kyi phral shor zhes bya'o/ yang*/ da lta dgos rgyu 'di lam yin la/ phyis nas 'bras bu gzhan zhig thob gyur 'dod pa la/ lam gyi ye shor zer la/ rang sems tha mal shes pa skyong ba 'dis go mi chod par/ blos byas kyi sgom bzang bzang por 'dod pa gcig logs su 'tshol ba la/

lam gyi phral shor zhes bya/ yang*/ nyon mongs lta bu skyes pa'i tshe de'i rang ngo lam khyer mi shes par/ theg pa 'og ma ltar thabs gzhan zhig bsgom pa ni/ gnyen po'i ye shor zer/ rnam rtog lta bu gang skyes lam du lhongs ma shes par/ rkyen de bkag pa'am/ bshig nas sgom la phab dgos na/ gnyen 438)po'i phral shor du gol/ yang*/ sems nyid ye stong rtsa bral gyi yin tshul ma go bar/ rang bzhin ma grub pa'o/ stong nyid du gyur pa'o/ snyam pa la sogs blos bcos pa dang*/ nyi tshe ba'i stong pa sogs/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su ye shor dang*/ sngon ma rnam rtog gi rjes su 'brengs nas yengs so/ da slar legs por bsgom mo snyam pa'i rtog pa kho rang 'phro 'thud pa'i ngang las song ba'am dran rig med kyang yod do snyam pa la sogs rgyas 'debs phral shor te/ mdor na gnas lugs kyi rang mtshang ma rig cing yin lugs kyi sgro 'dogs ma chod pa'i gnad kyis/ sgom 'dra min du shor ba'i rigs 'di dag dang gzhan yang sna tshogs 'byung nyen yod la 'dra min gyi sgom la ji tsam 'bungs kyang ngal ba don med dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni gnas 439)ngan len gyi rgyu rkyen byed pas/ des na sgom ma nor ba zhig gal che ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis sems rtog med bying rmugs la zhi gnas su 'dzin pa dang*/ rtog pas brtag dpyad la lhag mthong du brlom pa dang*/ a 'thas 'jur 'dzin la dran par 'dod pa dang*/ btang snyoms lung ma bstan la bcos min du nor ba dang*/ gnas lugs kyi rang zhal ma mthong ba'i tha mal pa'i shes pa phal pa dang bzo bcos med pa'i gnyug ma tha mal shes pa gnyis nor ba dang*/ ting 'dzin bzang zhen nam/ zag bcas kyi bde ba tsam la zug rngu med pa rang bzhin mchog gi bde bar 'dod pa dang*/ gnas lugs yul med rang ngo shes pa'i nges pa ma rnyed par snang yul la zhen 'dzin zhugs pa dang yul med 'dzin pa bral ba'i

440)rang gsal 'gags med gnyis nor ba dang*/ gsal cha 'gag pa'i gti mug la mi rtog ye shes su nor ba sogs/ mdor bsdus na/ nor 'khrul 'dra min shor gol gyi rigs mtha' dag 'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ dang por tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong sogs sngon 'gro la gnad du ma bsnun pas las ngan gyi dri ma ma dag pa dang*/ bar du byin rlabs kyi rlan gyis ma thul bas rang rgyud tha rgod du rengs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi sgro 'dogs thams cad sems thog tu ma chod pas kha chos tshig 'byams su dred pa dang*/ mtha' mar nyams len rgyud la ma khel bas chos min 'jig rten min gyi ser gzugs sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i rla tshong du gyur pa'i rigs can mang po snyigs ma'i yang tha 'dir mchis te/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ las kyi rnam smin rgyu 'bras mi 'dod pa// de ni mu stegs chad par smra ba ste// shi ma thag 441)tu mnar med dmyal bar skye// 'di ni gzhan phung rang yang rlag par byed/ ces gsungs pa de lta bur ma gyur pa'i rang mgo bsgrim pa la 'bad pa gal che bar gda'o/ de ltar lta sgom nor 'khrul shor gol gyi dbang du ma song bar mnyam bzhag la rtse gcig tu 'bad cing*/ rjes shes kyang blos btang tha mal 'khrul 'byams la mi bsdad par dran rig gis zin par byas na/ gang zag gi blo khyad dang dbang po'i rim pa gang yin dang mthun pa'i nyams rtogs 'byung la/ spyir mnyam rjes kyi skabs 'di la mkhas grub so so'i bzhed pa mi gcig pa du ma'i dbang gi ngos 'dzin tshul tha dad pa mang po 'byung ste/ la las rnal 'byor bzhi'i spros bral man chad la mnyam rjes dngos med par gsungs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis nyams kyi mnyam rjes dang rtogs pa'i 442)mnyam rjes so sor dbye ba dang*/ la las rnal 'byor bzhi so so la rang sa'i mnyam rjes re tha dad du gsungs pa sogs mtha' yas mod cing*/ de bzhin du nyams dang rtogs pa'i khyad par yang sna tshogs pa'i tshul dang*/

rtse gcig gsum ga nyams kho na las rtogs pa dngos min par gsungs pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni sgom med la zin tshe sems kyi ngo bo mthong bar bzhed pa sogs phra zhib kyi dbye chos grangs med pa zhig snang la/ gang zag gi mos khams bsam yas ji snyed kyi gdul thabs la dgongs pa'i thugs rje'i rnam rol yin phyir bden pa kho nar gor ma chags phyir skyabs su mchi zhing*/ kho bo ni de lta bu'i sa mtshams rnams su ma slebs ma mthong mi shes pas 'di dang 'di ni yin zhing 'thad la/ 'di dang 'di dag ni ma yin cing mi 'thad pa'i gtan tshigs 'di'o zhes ci zhig smra ste/ 443)dmus long gis kha dog bzang ngan gyi dbye ba mi nus pa lta bu'o/ 'on kyang rang skal gyi go tshod tsam la brten nas mdo tsam brjod na/ de yang mnyam rjes kyi ming 'dogs dang brda mtshon ni rim gnyis bsgom to cog la yod par grub la/ ci'i phyir na/ nyams su len rgyu'i dngos don de nyid bya byed gzhan dang ma bsres par chig dril du byed pa ni mnyam bzhag dang*/ de nyid thun mtshams sogs su gzhan dang bsre ba la rjes thob kyi tha snyad dang*/ de dus kyi shes pa la rjes shes dang*/ snang ba la rjes snang du tha snyad gdags tshul ni kun mthun pa'i phyir/ skabs 'di dag tu'ang*/ las dang po pa rnams sgom dngos la 'bad dus mnyam bzhag dang*/ bya byed 'gro 'chag za nyal sogs kyi tshe ni rjes kyi ming gdags su rung la/ rnal 'byor dam pa rnams la ni 444)rtag tu yengs 'khrul med tshe mnyam rjes dbyer med dam/ sgom khor yug ces bya'o/ de bzhin du nyams rtogs gnyis kyi shan 'byed kyang*/ sa mtshams mtho dman gang du yang rung ba'i dge sbyor de nyid sems kyi ngo bo dang ma 'dres par spang bya dang gnyen po lta bu'am/ bsgom bya sgom byed tha dad lta bu ni nyams yin la/ de dang sems gnyis tha mi dad par sems kho rang de'i ngo bor shar zhing thag chod kyi nges pa thob pa la rtogs pa zhes bya ste/

mdor na 'di gnyis ni sgom gyi skabs gcig pur ma zad de/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ram/ snying rje byang sems/ bskyed rim sogs lam gyi nyams len phal mo che la 'gro ste/ dper byas na/ rdo rje gdan lta bu gcig gi dbyibs dang bkod pa'i gnas tshul rnams gzhan gyi ngag las thob pa'i don 'ol spyi tsam rang gi yid la shar zhing gzhan 445)dag la 'chad nus pa de la go ba zer/ thag ring mo nas rdo rje gdan mthong ba'am/ bkod pa ri mor bris pa blta myong bas don phal cher tsam blo ngor chud pa de la myong ba'am nyams zhes bya/ rdo rje gdan du rang nyid kyis phyin nas zhib tu mthong zhing nges pa de la rtogs pa shar ba zer ba'i dpe de lta bu dang mtshungs la/ de rnams kyang blo ngor chud dka' sla ni gang zag so so'i dbang po'i rim pa gsum gyi khyad par te/ de yang brda bstan pa tsam mam skad cig tsam la go myong rtogs pa shar nas dka' bas 'bad mi dgos par yon tan myur du rdzogs pa ni/ cig car ba'i rigs zhes bya ste skyes chen sbyangs pa mngon gyur rnams so/ yang nyams rtogs yon tan rnams go rim ma yin par mtho dman nges med 'phel 'grib can du 'char 446)ba ni thod rgal ba zhes bya ste 'bring po'o/ gzhan gang zag thun mong ba spyi la nyams len brtson 'grus che chung ltar gyi go rim nges can du na 'phar ba'i rigs la rim gyis pa zhes bya ste phal pa rnams so/ des na rim gyis pa dang mthun pa'i lam rim la gzhan gnyis po'ang 'du bas de ltar du 'chad de/ spyir theg pa thun mong ba nas gsungs pa la sa bcu dang lam lngas sangs rgyas su bgrod mod kyi/ 'dir mnyam med dwags rgyud yab sras la sgos su grags pa'i rnal 'byor rim pa bzhi dang*/ de re re la che chung 'bring du phye ba'i bcu gnyis po 'di ni rgyud gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lung gi dgongs pa rje zla 'od gzhon nus gsal bar mdzad pa ste/

rgyud de nyid las/ seng ge rnam par 'gyings pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// mi g.yo rtse gcig 447)dwangs pa'i shes pa gsal// rang rig ye shes khong nas sad par byed// bzod pa brtan pos ngan song sdug bsngal spong*// gnyis pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// spros dang bral ba'i mnyam bzhag chen po las// bsam gyis mi khyab ting 'dzin rtsal du 'char// drod thob nas ni skye la dbang ba yin// gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// du ma ro gcig sa bcu'i rtogs pa shar// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan don mdzad// rtse mo thob nas 'phel ba rgyun mi chad// bzhi pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyi// bsgom du med pa'i nyams len brtson pa las// mkhyen pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas zhing khams mthong*// ma btsal lhun grub chos mchog chen po'i ngang*/ zhes gsungs pa 'di dang dgongs mthun lang kar gshegs pa'i mdor yang rgya cher 448)bstan pa dang*/ slob dpon shānti pas kyang gsal bar mdzad tshul rnams/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis zhib mor phyes shing*/ gzhan yang rnying lugs kyi phyag chen dag tu'ang gu ru rin po ches mdor bsdus nas gsungs te/ de yang gnad kyi zin tig las/ dge sdig sems su dag pas na// mi dge'i las rnams ngang gis spong*/ zhes rtse gcig dang*/ sems nyid spros dang bral bas ni// gzung dang 'dzin pa thams cad spong*/ zhes spros bral dang*/ snang ba chos kyi skur shar bas// rnam par rtog pa shugs kyi spong*/ zhes ro gcig dang*/ 'khor 'das rang bzhin med shes pas// gnyis su 'dzin pa thams cad spang*/ zhes bsgom med bstan/ yang dag spong ba bzhi dang rnal 'byor bzhi'i don sbyar nas gsungs pa dang*/ yang*/ drod ni sems kyi ngo bo mthong*// rtse 449)mos skye med chos skur rtogs// bzod pa 'khor 'das blang dor med/ chos mchog 'khor 'das sems su thim/

zhes sbyor lam nges byed bzhi dang rnal 'byor bzhi sbyar te gsungs pa sogs dgongs mthun du mchis shing*/ rnal 'byor bzhi po de dag gi dngos don ji ltar 'char tshul rim pa dang*/ zhar la mdo lugs kyi sa bcu lam lnga rdzogs tshul rnams sa bon tsam brjod na/ rtse gcig spros bral/ ro gcig bsgom med dang bzhi las dang po rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor ni/ de yang skal ldan gang zhig tshe'i zhen pa chod cing*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ste byin rlabs gsha' ma zhugs shing mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshe/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngang la gnas shing nges shes rnyed la/ rnam rtog shar ba bdag kyang ngo shes pas rang grol du 'gro ba la sgom 450)yin snyam pa'i 'dzin pa dang bcas pa 'byung ba de ni rtse gcig chung ngu ste/ sgrub rgyud gong ma dag rtse gcig gsum ga zhi gnas kho nar bzhed kyang*/ rang nyid kyi go tshod la ni gang zag gi rim pa tha dad kyi khyad ni los kyang mchis la/ gzhan ni gshis kyi yin lugs shes pa zhig la ni nam yang zhi lhag zung 'jug tu tshang ba chos nyid yin phyir/ 'dir yang lhag mthong gis zin par go'o/ 'di skabs kyi rjes shes ni a 'thas shas che zhing*/ gnyid kyi skabs su'ang tha mal pa dang khyad cher mi 'byung ste/ mdor na 'di dus ni dang po'i skabs yin tshe nyams len skyong bde mi bde sna tshogs mtho dman du yong ngo*/ rtse gcig 'bring gi tshe/ mnyam bzhag la ji tsam 'dod pa ltar gnas nus shing*/ res 'ga' ma bsgoms kyang ting 'dzin 451)'char/ rjes shes kyang a 'thas chung du 'gro ste/ snang ba gu yangs sangs kyi 'gyur ba dang*/ gnyid la yang skabs 'gar dge sbyor gyis sleb pa ste/ mdor na nam bsgom bsgom 'ong ba'i dus yin no/ de nas rtse gcig chen po ni mnyam bzhag bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams de nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'ong ba dang*/ rjes snang rjes shes sogs kyi dbye ba med par ting 'dzin de la rgya 'byams su 'gyur/

phyi nang gi srin bu med cing 'dod yon la zhen pa mi 'jug pa dang*/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs kyang thob par gsungs shing*/ 'on kyang 'di man chad bzang zhen gyi nyams dang ma bral zhing sgo 'dzin gyi blos 'ching ba ma grol bar mchis so/ de ltar rtse gcig gsum gyi sna zin gyi dbang rim gyi khyad dang brtson 'grus che chung sogs las/ rang sa'i khyad 452)par du ma yod de/ de yang bde gsal mi rtog gi ngo bo de ka la rang rig nges shes kyi gdengs rnyed ma rnyed kyi bye brag la rtse gcig ngo bo mthong ma mthong du dbye ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ nyams de 'khor yug dang res 'jog gi khyad la rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs su 'byed pa dang*/ rnam rtog shar tshad dran pas sleb tsam gyis sgom du 'gro mi 'gro la/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar zhes brjod pa dang*/ blo rgyud las rung du gyur ma gyur la yon tan skyes ma skyes kyi tha snyad dang*/ rjes shes su bcos min gyi snying rje skye mi skye'i khyad kyis gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs dang*/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la nges shes rnyed ma rnyed kyis kun rdzob la byan tshud ma tshud kyi dbye ba 'di rnams kyis 'dzin dgos par bka' rgyud gong ma rnams gsungs so/ de lta bu'i 453)rtse gcig gi nyams myong ji ltar skyes bzhin du bdag lta'i rlom sems dang bzang zhen gyi skyon dbang du ma shor bar gsol 'debs dang nyams len la 'bad na/ spros bral du 'phar bar 'gyur ba ste/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi mtha' dang bral ba'i yin lugs tshul bzhin rtogs/ rjes shes kyang dran pas nam zin mnyam bzhag gi ngang du song bas grol yang*/ dran pas ma zin na a 'thas su 'char la/ rmi lam du yang 'khrul ma 'khrul nges med du 'byung zhing*/ gang ltar 'di skabs su snang srid kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid kho na'o snyam pa la sogs pa'i stong 'dzin dang bcas pa 'di spros bral chung ngu yin la/

spros bral 'bring gi tshe/ stong 'dzin de dang rnam rtog gi rang bzhin la bden zhen sogs dag kyang*/ phyi'i snang ba la bden 'dzin cung zhig ma dag 454)pa dang*/ rjes dang gnyid kyi skabs la'ang 'khrul 'dzin a 'thas yod med sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ dge sbyor la mtho dman 'phel 'grib kyang du ma 'byung ngo*/ spros bral chen po ni 'khor 'das dang phyi nang snang sems sogs la sgro 'dogs gting nas chod de/ snang mi snang stong mi stong sogs kyi zhen pa las grol/ nyin snang phal cher sgom la rgyud chad med la/ rmi lam du 'khrul 'dzin skabs 'gar 'ong bar bshad cing*/ 'on kyang 'di dus dran pa rgyun chad med par ni ma 'gyur pas zung dran cung zhig dgos pa nyid do/ mdor na spros bral gyi skabs 'di dag tu stong nyams gtso bor 'char zhing gang la'ang bden 'dzin med pa'i nyams kho na shar ba'i gnad kyis/ mos gus dag snang snying rje sogs kyang chung du 'gro ba srid pas/ stong pa dgrar langs kyi gegs dbang du ma 455)shor ba gal che zhing*/ 'di skabs su stong 'dzin nyams kyi dri ma'am nges shes kyi cha dag ma dag gi khyad par la spros bral ngo bo mthong ma mthong gi dbye ba dang*/ snang thog stong thog gang la yang re dogs bral ma bral lam sgro 'dogs chod ma chod la/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi tha snyad dang*/ 'gyu rtog mtha' dag stong nyid kho nar rang ngo shes pa'i mnyam bzhag rtogs pa de nyid rjes snang dang gnyid gnyis kar sleb ma sleb la/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar dang*/ rtogs don gyi bden pa mthong ba'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs grub rtags kyi snang cha dang 'brel ma 'brel la yon tan skyes ma skyes dang*/ stong nyid kyi rtsal mdangs rgyu 'bras su shar tshul la nges shes rnyed nas sems bskyed smon lam gyi rten 'brel bsgrig shes mi shes la kun rdzob la byan tshud ma tshud dang*/

gzugs 456)sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs sogs kyi dbye ba'i sa mtshams shes dgos par gsungs so// de lta bu'i spros bral gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ 'khor 'das/ snang stong*/ bskyed rdzogs/ kun rdzob don dam la sogs gnyis chos kyi dbye ba dang ming 'dogs mtha' dag phyag rgya chen por ro gcig par rtogs shing*/ lam gyi chos ji snyed ma lus rang rig gi thog tu 'dril thub kyang*/ de la myong 'dzin nam nges shes kyi 'khris cung zad yod pa'i bar ni ro gcig chung ngu*/ myong 'dzin de nyid dag nas snang sems dbyer med kyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing*/ rtogs bya'i yul dngos dang rtogs mkhan gyi rig pa so sor ma grub gcig tu'ang mi 'dzin te/ gzung 'dzin gnyis las grol ba ni ro gcig 'bring po/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu shar ba'i mthu las ro gcig gi rtogs pa de nyid du ma 457)ru 'char ba'i ye shes kyi rtsal rgyas pa ni ro gcig chen po ste/ sgrub rgyud gong ma rnams kyis mnyam rjes 'dres pa mtshan nyid pa de 'di skabs su 'byung bar gsungs so/ de yang gang shar gyi snang rtog rnams gshis ngo'i cha nas chos sku'am phyag chen du ye nas yin na'ang*/ snang ngo'am 'khrul ngo la a 'thas dang gzung 'dzin sogs su yod pa 'di la rang rig gi dran pas sleb na rang sar grol ba ni rnal 'byor 'og ma rnams la yod mod kyang*/ skabs 'dir slebs tshe dran pas zin rgyu'am ngo shes rgyu'i ngo bo logs su ma dgos par gang snang cir shar gyis chog par 'gyur ba yin tshe/ de ltar du gyur ma gyur la ro gcig gi ngo bo mthong ma mthong du dbye ba dang*/ gnyen po'i zhen 'dzin phra mo yod med dam/ ro gcig du mar 'char 458)mi 'char gyi khyad la rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs su 'byed pa dang*/ tshogs drug gi snang ba zang thal du 'char ba'i sgo thams cad la bcings grol med par gyur ma 'gyur la rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar gyi tha snyad dang*/

mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis phyi nang gi chos so cog la dbang bsgyur zhing sprul bsgyur rdzu 'phrul la rang dbang thob ma thob la yon tan skyes ma skyes su btags pa dang*/ snang sems 'dres pas ro gcig du mar 'char ba'i rtogs pa'i rten 'brel snang srid rang dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyu 'bras lam du lhongs ma lhongs la/ kun rdzob la byan tshud du byed pa dang*/ kun khyab rtsol med kyi snying rje'i shugs las gzhan don gyi gter kha phye ma phye la/ gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs ma thebs su brjod pa'i tshul rnams yod do// de nas ro gcig mthar 459)phyin tshe/ ched du bsgom ma bsgom yengs ma yengs la sogs pa'i gnyis snang dag nas snang ba thams cad sgom du ye yin chen por grol la/ 'on kyang mtshan mo'i dus dang gzhan du'ang rjes snang gi bag chags sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dzin pa phra mo tsam skye ba ni bsgom med chung ngu*/ sgyu 'dzin de yang rtsa ba nas dag cing nyin mtshan khor yug tu mnyam bzhag chen po gcig tu gyur te gshis lugs mngon du gyur yang*/ ye shes kyi rang grib rnam shes kyi cha phra mo rang gsal du yod pa de shes bya'i dri ma yin pas/ de dang ma bral ba ni bsgom med 'bring po/ mi rtog ngo ma shes sam/ shes sgrib phra mo kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi lhag rol lta bu de nyid kyang gtan nas sangs te/ 'od gsal ma bu 'dres shing thams cad ye shes kyi 460)klong 'byams chos sku thig le nyag gcig tu smin pa de la bsgom med chen po'am/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ste 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'o/ de yang ro gcig mngon gyur gyi rtogs pa de ka la slar bsgom rgyu'i goms par bya rgyu lta bu'i myong shes dag ma dag gi khyad par la bsgom med kyi ngo bo mthong ma mthong zer/ rtogs pa'i ye shes de la mi shes kyi dri ma'am shes bya'i bag chags phra zhing phra ba'i rnam pa thams cad zad la bsgom med rtsal rdzogs kyi dbye ba dang*/

kun gzhi'i bag chags nyid chos dbyings ye shes kyi ngang du thim ma thim la rnam rtog bsgom du shar ma shar gyi tha snyad dang*/ gdos bcas 'ja' lus dang sems nyid chos sku/ zhing khams dag pa rab 'byams su snang mi snang ngam grol ma grol la yon tan skyes ma skyes dang*/ sku gsung thugs mi zad rgyan 'khor 461)gyis mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don rtsol med du mdzad mi mdzad la/ gzugs sku'i sa bon mngon du gyur ma gyur dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs ma rdzogs la kun rdzob kyi cha shas mtha' dag dbyings su dag ma dag sogs kyi dbye ba phra zhib ma lus pa rnams bka' rgyud gong ma rnams kyis gsal bar mdzad mod cing*/ mdor hril gyis dril ba'i don las/ mnyam bzhag la ji tsam 'dod par gnas thub pa la rtse gcig zer/ tha mal gyi shes pa rang ngo shes shing gzhi rtsa med par rtogs pa la spros bral zer/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi 'dzin pa rig thog tu grol ba la ro gcig zer/ nges shes dang bag chags kyi dri ma thams cad dag pa la sgom med zer ba ste/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i ngo bo ni 'dir 'dus shing*/ bye brag tu 462)rtse gcig gi mnyam rjes kyi khyad ni gnas mi gnas la 'dod cing*/ spros bral gyi mnyam rjes ni dran ma dran dang*/ ro gcig yan chad ni mnyam rjes 'dres pas dbyer med do/ yang rnam rtog gi rang bzhin mi rtog par 'char ba ni rtse gcig stong nyid du 'char ba spros bral/ mnyam nyid du 'char ba ro gcig blo 'das su shar ba la bsgom med ces bya/ yang rtse gcig dus su 'khrul pa rang ga mar mchar/ spros bral nas gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs/ ro gcig gi tshe 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char/ bsgom med la 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi ming dang bral lo/ gzhan yang rtse gcig gnas 'gyu gnyis dbyer med du rtogs pa ni mchog yin/ spros bral la 'khrul grol dbyer med/ ro gcig la snang sems dbyer med/

bsgom med la snang sems 463)dbyer med rnams ni so so'i rtsal rdzogs pa'am/ mchog tu gyur par gsungs pa dang*/ yang rtse gcig sems nyid a 'thas kyi dus/ spros bral gyi sems nyid mnyam rjes/ ro gcig gi sems nyid zung 'jug bsgom med kyi sems nyid mngon gyur/ ces gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rtse gcig gi tshe rnam rtog gi mgo non/ spros bral gyi rnam rtog rtsa ba chod/ ro gcig gi rang byung ye shes nang nas shar/ bsgom med ni de la brtan pa thob pa'o/ zhes sogs/ mdor na dbye bsal dang rnam grangs kyi rim pa ni brjod kyis mi langs shing zad mtha' med pa zhig snang mod kyi/ 'gag don du dgos gal che ba ni gnas lugs sems kyi rang mtshang ji bzhin pa zhig ngo shes nas/ blos byas kyis ma bslad pa'i rang babs tha mal shes pa'i 464)rang 'gros skyong tshul shes pa zhig kho na gal che bar gda' ste/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ cir snang sgom du ma shes na// gnyen po bsten gyis ga la langs// yul rkyen spangs pas mi spong ste// sgyu mar shes na rang sar grol/ ces gsungs shing*/ ding sang gi chos par rlom pa phal mo che ni 'jig rten gyi 'khri ba dam pos bcings shing*/ tshe 'di'i lto gos skyid 'dod zang zing yo byad 'dzom cha don du gnyer ba kho na dang*/ la la ni tha snyad thos rgya shes rlom nga rgyal gyi dug gis smyos nas rang sems la rang dbang ma thob/ 'ga' zhig tsam nges don sgom phyogs la blo 'dun par gyur yang*/ bla ma dang gdams ngag zol med kyis 'phongs te/ sdug btsir 'jur sgom gyi btson du chud cing*/ gu yangs khyab gdal gyi nyams len ma shes pas srog rlung rin gyis 465)nyo ba'i blun sgom mang la/ gzhan dag phal cher ni nag po kha 'byams glo ba'i thug pa'am rbud pa'i rkyal stong 'dra ba'i sgom chen gyis ri klungs gang ba'i dus 'di 'drar/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i yon tan brjod rung mya ngam gyi thang la chu'i yon tan bshad pa lta bu las ma mchis shing dgos pa chung la/

nyams rtogs lhad med skyes pa'i skal ldan kho thag chod pa dag ni bsgoms byung gi shes rab nang nas shar ba'i phyi rol gyi tshig dang yi ge la rag ma lus phyir bdag 'dra'i ma mthong rgyang gi gtam rgyud lta bu'i bshad tshogs la dgos pa med par 'khums so/ gang zhig skal bzang brtson 'grus can dam pa bsten cing byin rlabs zhugs te nyams len phur tshugs su bgyid nus pa'i gang zag tshad ldan dag gis 466)'di dang gzhan nas bshad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi ji lta ba'i nyams rtogs shar ba dag la ni/ theg pa thun mong ltar gyi lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rim pa rnams kyang shugs la tshang zhing bgrod pa ste/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ mi gang ting 'dzin mchog 'di 'dzin pa ni// chos 'dzin de dag gang du song ba yang*// shin tu spyod pa zhi zhing yid rang bzhin// rab tu dga' dang dri med 'od byed dang*// 'od 'phro sbyang dka' mngon du gyur ba'i sa// ring du song dang mi g.yo legs pa'i blo// chos sprin sa bcu po yang thob par 'gyur/ ces gsungs shing*/ de yang dang po tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum la dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi dang*/ yang dag par spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rnams 'byung ba las/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gi myur lam 'dir 467)de thams cad tshang ba'i tshul ni/ de la dang por sngon 'gro thun mong ba'i nang tshan gyi/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ tshe mi rtag bsam pa sogs la/ lus mi gtsang bar dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang*/ tshor ba sdug bsngal bar dran pa/ sems mi rtag par dran pa/ chos bdag med par dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang bzhi po shugs kyis tshang phyir/ de dag la gnad du bsnun te myong ba'am nges shes skyes tshe/ tshogs lam chung ngu bgrod pa zhes bya'o/ de bzhin du mi dge'i chos rnams mi bskyed cing skyes pa rnams spong ba dang*/ dge ba'i chos rnams bskyed cing skyes pa rnams gong du spel ba ste/

de ltar yang dag spong ba bzhi rnams ni 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya maṇḍal rnams la 'dus phyir/ tshogs lam 'bring po bgrod/ de nas 468)bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ de yang bla ma la mos gus rtse gcig byed pa ni 'dun pa rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni brtson 'grus kyi rkang pa/ dbang bzhi len pa ni spyod pa'i rkang pa/ mthar bla ma rang sems dang bsre ba ni sems kyi ting 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ste/ de dag gis tshogs lam chen po bgrod pa'o/ de yang phar phyin theg pa tshogs lam mthar phyir pa'i yon tan du dag pa'i zhing khams bgrod cing sangs rgyas sprul pa sku'i zhal mthong ba sogs 'byung bar gsungs pa la/ 'dir ni bla ma mchog nyid sangs rgyas sku gsum ga'i ngo bor gyur pa dang*/ de nyid kyi gdul zhing thams cad sprul pa'i zhing las ma 'das phyir don gyi dgongs pa mthun pa nyid do/ de nas rtse gcig gi skabs chung 'bring che gsum ni sbyor lam yin cing*/ sems kyi ngo bo 469)mthong ba la drod ces bya ba dang*/ de la nges shes skyes pa la rtse mor brjod pa dang*/ rkyen gyis mi gnod pa la bzod pa zhes pa dang*/ rtse gcig gi nyams kyi khor yug la sbyor lam 'jig rten chos mchog tu bzhed pa ste/ 'di dag gi skabs su yon tan gyi bye brag tu dbang po lnga yang 'byung ste/ gang zhe na/ nges shes tshad med skyes pa dad pa'i dbang po dang*/ yengs med don la blta ba dran pa'i dbang po/ le los bar mi chod pa brtson grus kyi dbang po/ sgom la rgyun chad med pa ting 'dzin gyi dbang po/ nges pa'i don rtogs pa shes rab kyi dbang po lnga 'byung zhing*/ de lnga po so so nas rtsal rdzogs pa'am stobs su gyur pa la stobs lngar yang brjod pa ste/ de ltar rtse gcig gsum mngon du gyur pas sbyor lam mthar phyin nas/

spros 470)bral la sleb pa dang sngar ma mthong ba'i rtogs don gyi bden pa mthong lam bgrod pa ste/ 'di skabs su phar phyin theg par byang chub kyi yan lag bdun bsgom par gsungs pa rnams kyang 'dir shugs la 'byung ba nyid/ de yang chos kyi gnas lugs kyi don ji bzhin pa'i ngang la gnas pas/ ting 'dzin byang chub kyi yan lag dang*/ nyon mongs dang ma 'dres pas na chos rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag ting 'dzin de nyid dran pa tsam gyis mthong spangs kyi dri ma rang sar dag pas dran pa byang chub kyi yan lag le lo g.yeng ba las grol bas brtson grus byang chub kyi yan lag zag med kyi dga' bde la spyod pas dga' ba byang chub kyi yan lag spang bya ma lus dag pas shin tu sbyangs pa byang chub kyi yan lag 471)'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pas btang snyoms byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun po rdzogs par gyur la gzhan yang mthong lam gyi yon tan du ma dang ting 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa thob par gsungs so/ de yang 'ga' zhig gi bzhed kyis spros bral gsum ga'i rtsal rdzogs nas ro gcig tu na 'phar ba'i tshe/ sgom lam dang sa dang po zin par bzhed la/ gzhan dag phal cher ni spros bral ngo bo mthong zhing mthong lam skyes pa'i rjes thog de kar sa dang po thob par bshad pa mang ste gang zag gi dbang po rim pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges par mngon te/ lam bgrod khams che chung dang myur bul gyi khyad sna tshogs 'byung bar gor ma chags so/ de ltar gyi mthong lam gyi rtogs pa gsha' ma skyes tshe yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung 'khungs sam/ gzhi rten byed 472)phyir sa zhes bya ba thob pa ste/ sangs rgyas phal chen gyi mdo las/ sa thob gyur ma thag tu 'jigs pa lnga dang bral// 'tshe ba med dang 'chi dang ngan 'gror mi ltung dang*// 'khor gyi nang du 'jigs bral de la bag tsha med/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ sa bcu'i yon tan rnams gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur la/

sa thob yan chad la sgom lam zhes bya ba ste/ ci'i phyir na/ mthong lam gyi don de la goms par byed pas na de skad du brjod la/ 'di dus 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la spyod pa ste/ de nyid la'ang mnyam bzhag thams cad zag med kyi ting 'dzin kho na dang*/ rjes snang 'phags lam yan lag brgyad de goms par byed pa la zag bcas su bshad cing*/ brgyad po gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang*/ rtogs pa dang*/ ngag dang*/ las kyi mtha' dang*/ 'tsho ba dang*/ rtsol ba dang*/ dran pa dang 473)yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin te/ mdor na 'di dag thams cad phyin ci ma log pa'i chos can 'ba' zhig tu 'grub phyir/ theg pa 'og ma dag gi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ldog chos du ma can sha stag go sa rnams kyi dang po ni/ yon tan khyad par can de la dga' ba mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba zhes bya zhing*/ 'di dus mnyam bzhag skye med rtog bral gyi ngang dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas sems can gyi don la mgo dang yan lag sogs gtang ba la yang nyam nga dang zhum pa med pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gtso bor bsgrubs pas lam bgrod pa sogs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang sa bcu po rim can du sbyar nas gsungs pa dag thun mong theg par zhib rgyas 'byung mod 474)kyi/ 'dir ni spros bral dang por ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba cher rgyas pas sa dang por rab tu dga' ba/ sgom spangs kyi dri ma dang bral bas sa gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ rtogs don gyi rtsal las 'gro ba'i don byed pas sa gsum pa 'od byed pa spros bral 'bring por/ sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan gong du 'phel bas sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba/ stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi rtogs pas bag chags kyi dri ma sbyangs dka' thams cad sbyong bas lnga pa sbyangs dka' ba/ spros bral chen po mngon du gyur te 'khor 'das skye med du rtogs pas drug pa mngon gyur gyi sa rnams non pa ste/

'di man chad nyan rang rnams dang thun mong gi sar bshad la/ de nas mnyam rjes 'khor 'das sogs gnyis snang phal cher zung 'jug tu grol te ro gcig gi rtogs pa shar ba'i thog mar sa bdun 475)pa ring du song ba/ ro gcig 'bring por rtogs chos yang dag gi dran pa las g.yo ba med pas brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i sa/ ro gcig chen por gnyis snang sgyu ma lta bu phra mo tsam ma gtogs gzhan dri ma phal cher dag pas sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ gnyis snang phra mo de yang rang sar dag ste sa lam gyi yon tan mthar phyin la/ 'on kyang kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi lhag ma'i dri ma'am bag chags kyi 'dzin cha shes bya'i sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba zhig yod pa'i bar de la 'dir sgom med chung 'bring dang*/ thun mong ba ltar na sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin zhes bya zhing*/ de ltar 'di man chad ni byang sems sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa'i yon tan mnga' la/ de nas mi rtog ngo ma shes kyi dri ma'am shes 476)bya'i bag chags phra mo de nyid kyang rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rang byung rang rig chen por thim zhing sgrib byed mtha' dag gtan bral du gyur nas/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal dang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i stobs rnams yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe phyi thun mong theg par mthar phyin pa'i lam mchog rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dngos dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i skabs 'dir ni bsgom med chen por brjod la/ gsang sngags spyi ltar na 'di dus las nyon bag chags kyi sgrib cha zad pas lam sbyang bgrod dngos byed rgyu med kyang*/ yon tan gyi 'phel cha'i ldog chos sam khyad chos kyi bye brag las btags te/ bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang*/ bcu gnyis ma chags padma'i sa ste/ thun mong ma yin pa nang gi sa gnyis po skad cig la mngon du byas nas/ rang don chos sku mthar phyin pa'i

477)rol rtsal las gzhan don gzugs skus mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don chen 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad pa la bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid du gsungs so/ 'di dag las sa lam gong du bgrod rgyu yod pa'i bar ni slob lam du brjod cing*/ gong du bgrod yul med par mthar thug tshe mi slob pa'i lam du brjod pa ste/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa ni gsang sngags nang pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin pa nyid do/ de lta bu'i sa rnams thob pa'i tshe yon tan khyad par ci lta bu yod ce na/ sa dang po thob pa tsam gyis phyogs bcur sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya dus gcig la bgrod nus pa dang*/ sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal blta zhing chos nyan pa dang*/ lus srog longs spyod rgyal srid bu dang chung ma sogs kyang ltos med du gtong nus pa'i sbyin pa mi 'dra ba brgya phrag dus 478)gcig la byed nus pa dang*/ 'od dmar po spro zhing dkar por bsdu ba dang*/ ser por spros nas sngon por 'khyil ba dang*/ mang por spros shing nyung ngur bsdu ba sogs 'od zer mi 'dra ba brgya dus gcig la 'gyed nus pa dang*/ gdul bya mi 'dra ba brgya la so so'i khams dbang bsam pa dang mthun pa'i chos sgo brgya phrag dus gcig la ston nus pa dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*/ dpung bkod pa dang*/ seṅge rnam par bsgyings pa la sogs rgyal ba'i yum las gsungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba rgya la dus gcig tu snyoms par 'jug nus pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'gro zhing sa la 'dzul ba/ ri brag la thogs pa med cing chu la mi bying ba/ stod nas me 'bar zhing smad nas chu 'brub pa'am/ de gnyis re mos dang*/ gcig las mang por sprul zhing mang po gcig tu bsdu ba'i 479)sprul bsgyur sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba brgya phrag dus gcig la ston nus pa ste/ de ltar yon tan brgya phrag bdun la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur la/

de bzhin du rim pas/ sa gnyis pa la yon tan de lta bu stong phrag bdun/ bzhi par 'bum phrag bdun/ lnga pa la bye ba phrag bdun/ drug par sa ya bdun/ bdun par dung phyur bdun/ brgyad par ther 'bum bdun/ dgu par ther 'bum chen po bdun/ bcu pa la ded 'dren phrag bdun dang*/ bcu gcig par rab bkram phrag bdun/ bcu gnyis pa la rab bkram chen po phrag bdun du 'gyur zhing bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas sku gsum bdag nyid mngon du gyur pa'i che ba'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs ni mtha' yas phyir su zhig gis tshad 'dzin par mi nus te blo'i ra ba las brgal ba'i chos 480)nyid do/ de lta bu thun mong theg pa nas gsungs pa'i sa bcu lam lnga thams cad theg pa'i yang rtse phyag rgya chen po'i lam 'dir ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su tshang phyir/ rnal 'byor bzhi po tshul bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i gang zag la sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag kyang rim gyis dang cig car du rdzogs pa chos nyid yin la/ 'on kyang ltar snang du la lar de dag sogs kyi yon tan mngon mtshan can du snang mi ston pa ni gsang sngags gsang ba'i nye lam gyi ya tshul kyang yin la/ gzhan yang dper na 'dab chags dang gcan gzan sogs sems can phal mo che ni ma'i mngal nas btsas te yun ring por ma song gi bar du lus rtsal mi rdzogs shing rim gyis ma dang mnyam par 'gyur mod la/ 'dab chags kyi dbang po bya khyung dang*/ gcan gzan gyi rgyal po seṅge ni sgong shun dang ma'i mngal du 481)rtsal rdzogs par gyur pa de gzhan gyis mi mthong mod kyang*/ nam zhig btsas par gyur ma thag rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i mthus/ ma dang lhan cig gnam 'phang gcod pa sogs rang gi bya ba mtha' dag nus pa de bzhin du/ 'dir yang rnal 'byor pa gang zhig gdos bcas lus la 'thum pa'i ring la mngon rtags gsal bar mi snang yang*/ nam zhig lus rgya grol ba dang yon tan gyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu smin pa dus mtshungs par 'gyur ba dang*/

'on te thabs shes zung 'jug gi lam la gnad du bsnun pa gang zhig la lus thog 'di nas rdzu 'phrul mngon shes sogs kyi lam rtags gsal bar snang ba'ang shin tu mang la don dam par ni/ dbyings dang ye shes mnyam pa nyid blo las 'das pa'i chos nyid rang sems dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs gnyug ma 482)don gyi ye shes la rang dbang ma thob na/ bskyed rdzogs rtsa rlung thig le sogs kyi nyams len drod rtags sna 'ga' tsam la dga' brod mchog 'dzin bzang zhen mngon rlom gyi 'gong po phugs su zhugs pa'i grub thob kyi rang gzhan ngan 'gror khyu ded byed pa ni ding sang gi dus 'dir shin tu mang bas/ dpyod ldan rnams kyis gzigs 'tshal lo/ de ltar lta sgom sa lam gyi rim pa cung zad bstan nas/ zhar la bogs 'don lam 'khyer gyi spyod pa'i tshul yang mdo tsam 'chad de/ de yang spyir gsang sngags kyi lam phal mo che las spyod pa'i rnam grangs ni/ spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum mam gsang spyod/ tshogs spyod/ rig pa brtul zhugs phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs dbye rim mang yang*/ phal cher bskyed rdzogs thun mong gi bogs 483)'don shas che zhing*/ 'dir ni gnyug ma blo bral gyi rang 'gros skyong ba kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa kho na gces te/ de las dang por sngon 'gro tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong byin rlabs 'jug thabs kyi rim pa'i skabs su yang tshe 'di'i bya byed 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri ma gang gis kyang ma bslad cing*/ rang sems rang la mi khrel ba'i nyams len gyi spyod pa kun tu bzang po la 'bad/ bar du dngos gzhi lta sgom gyi brdar sha gcod cing*/ rang rig gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus su yang blo mang gi gzer mgo nang nas brdungs la sgro 'dogs kyi snyems thag sems thog tu gcod/ gcig shes kun la mkhas shing kun shes gcig tu grol ba'i spyod pa kun tu bzang po la 'bungs/

mthar nyams len gyi bogs 'don par byed pa'i thabs kyi spyod pa'i bye 484)brag kyang*/ gzhung dang man ngag rnams nas sna tshogs 'byung mod kyi/ 'gag don gyi snying por ni/ 'jig rten gyi 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad de mi med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grim pa ri dwags rmas ma lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ rkyen ngan la ya nga bag tsha med pa seṅge ri sul bsnyegs pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ 'dod yon la chags zhen med pa bar snang gi rlung lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ chos brgyad la dgag sgrub kyi 'khris mi 'jug pa smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa dang*/ rang sems kyi rang 'gros kha yan du skyong ba las gzhan pa'i gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pas mi bcing ba nam mkha' mdung bskor lta bu'i spyod pa rnams la spyad cing*/ yengs 'khrul rnam g.yeng re dogs kyi 'ching ba bcad/ rtags mtshan nyams rtogs dngos grub sogs yong bar 'dod pa'i khong mtshang spu rtse tsam zhugs kyang gnas lugs chos sku'i rang zhal sgrib byed 'ba' 485)zhig yin pas/ bzo med gshis kyi 'dug tshul skyong ba kho na la dril ba ni lam khyer gyi spyod pa kun tu bzang po mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ gnas skabs su rkyen gyi bye brag ltar snang ba'i rnam rtog nyon mongs/ sdug bsngal/ 'jigs skrag na tsha 'chi ba dang bcas pa gang byung yang*/ gnyen po'am phan thabs gzhan la mi re mi ltos par/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i nyams len gyi dngos gzhir shes pa ni bogs 'don thams cad kyi rgyal po yin pas/ 'di lta bu nyams su len nus pa'i rnal 'byor de ni/ 'khor 'das snang srid kun la rang dbang bsgyur phyir/ bar chad kyi yul dang bral/ dngos grub kyi mtsho chen rdol/ sgrib gnyis kyi mun pa sangs/ grub rtags kyi nyi ma shar/ sangs rgyas sems la brnyed/ gzhan don gyi gter kha phye ba chos nyid yin yang*/ gcig chog gi 486)nor bu lag tu len pa de thang la bskyur nas/

byis pa pad tshal du slebs pa ltar 'di byed 'di bzang gi yid smon la mi tshe skyel ba'i sgom chen sha stag snang ba 'di ni yid skyo ba'i rgyur gda' lags so/ de ltar gzhi lam lta sgom gyi rang bzhin mdo tsam bstan nas/ da ni 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po sku gsum dbyer med dam/ sku gnyis zung 'jug gi don bshad pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ rnal 'byor gang zhig gnas lugs gzhi'i phyag chen gyi rang zhal mthong zhing*/ lta sgom lam gyi phyag chen la nyams len gnad du bsnun pas gom pa mthar phyin pa de nyid/ mthar thug 'bras bu'i phyag chen don dam chos sku mngon du gyur pa de'i tshe/ chos sku'i ngo bo ni rang rig bcos min gdod ma'i ye shes 'pho 'gyur bri gang med pa khams gsum sems can kun gyi rgyud la ye khyab tu bzhugs pa 487)'di nyid lam nyams len gyi thabs gnad zab mos mngon du byas pa ste/ 'di las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas sam/ chos sku zhes pa sngar med gsar byung ni ma yin no/ 'di'i mtshan nyid ni/ gnas lugs ji lta ba dang shes bya ji snyed pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba'i phyir mkhyen pa gnyis ldan yang zer la/ gdod nas ngo bo rnam par dag pa dang blo bur lhan skyes kyi dri ma dag pa'i phyir/ dag pa gnyis ldan yang zer te/ don la shes bya'i chos thams cad la mi mkhyen pa'am mi gzigs pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing*/ yon tan gyi cha mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs pa nyid do/ chos sku de'i gdangs sam ye shes kyi rol pa 'gag med du longs sprul gnyis shar ba ste/ sku gsum po de la zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan gyi yon tan 488)mnga' ba ste/ bdun gang zhe na/ 'og min gyi gnas su sems dpa' rnams la zab rgyas gsang sngags kyi chos 'khor la rtag pa rgyun gyi longs spyod mdzad phyir longs spyod kyi yan lag dang*/ 1 mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyid rang 'od kyi yum dang sbyor bas kha sbyor gyi yan lag dang*/

2 zag med kyi bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pas bde ba chen po'i yan lag dang gsum ni longs sku'i khyad chos yin la/ 3 dmigs med kyi thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab pa ni snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag 4 phrin las rgya chen po 'khor ba'i mtha' mnyam rtog med lhun grub tu 'byung ba ni rgyun mi chad pa'i yan lag 5 myang 'das zhi ba'i mthar mi gnas pa ni/ 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag ste/ 6 'di gsum ni sprul pa sku'i khyad chos yin pa dang*/ stong nyid snying 489)rje zung 'jug spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ni/ rang bzhin med pa'i yan lag ste/ 7 'di ni chos sku'i khyad chos su 'dren pa ste/ de ltar yan lag bdun ldan dang*/ yang dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan par yang 'dren te de yang sku gang la gang 'dul rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa ni sku'i dbang phyug 1 gang 'dul chos 'khor rgyun mi 'chad pa ni gsung gi dbang phyug 2 rtog med thugs rje mnga' ba ni thugs kyi dbang phyug 3 rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa ni rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang phyug 4 'khor 'das dus gsum mnyam nyid ro gcig tu mngon par byang chub pa ni kun 'gro'i dbang phyug 5 ri rab so gnyis kyi rdul grangs mnyam pa'i lha mos 'dod yon gyis mchod kyang 'dod pas gos ba med pa ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 6 491)yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid mthun du skong bas ci 'dod skyes pa'i dbang phyug 7 'og min chos dbyings pho brang na khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rtag tu bzhugs pa ni gnas kyi dbang phyug ste/ 8 de ltar dbang phyug brgyad ldan du 'dren pa 'di ni gtso cher longs sku'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs yin la/ sprul pa'i sku ni/ chos longs gnyis kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam yas kyi gdul bya 'gro ba'i chu snod ji snyed par 'dul byed sprul pa'i zla snang de snyed du 'byung ste/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub chen po la sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul bkod rab 'byams mtha' yas par 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo zhes bya zhing*/

de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu ni da lta lam gyi skabs su don dam 491)stong nyid phyag rgya chen po la gnad du bsnun pa'i 'bras bu dngos ni chos kyi sku 'grub cing*/ de'i yan lag gam thabs kyi char sems bskyed smon lam sogs rnam par dag pa bgyis pa'i mthu las sprul pa'i sku dang*/ bskyed rim zab mo bsgom pa'i rgyu 'bras las longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste nyams len de dag kyang so so ya bral res 'jog lta bu ni ma yin par thabs shes zung 'jug 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por 'bad pa'i mthu 'bras las sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i ngo bor gtan srid zin par 'gyur ba'o/ de ltar sngar bshad pa'i sku gsum po dang gzhan yang sku bzhi'am lnga sogs kyi dbya ba du ma rnams kyi ngo bo gcig la yon tan dang byed las lta bu'i cha nas ming so sor btags pa ste 492)da lta sems nyid kyi gshis gdangs rtsal gsum la de tshe sku gsum du brjod pa nyid las gzhan ma yin no/ 'di skabs su rgyu'i theg pa dang sngags 'og ma'i rgyud sde sogs su de dang de'i skabs don la dgongs pa dang*/ ldem por dgongs pa'i lung phyogs re'i kha 'dzin gyi bzhed srol sna tshogs te/ chos kyi sku la zhal phyag tu grub ma grub dang*/ de'i zhing khams dngos bstan yod med sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas la rang rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i ye shes yod med dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis la rang snang gi tshor ba yod med sogs kyi rtsod gzhi dang dgag sgrub du mas zing zing por byed par snang mod kyi/ de thams cad rang rang gi skabs der ni de nyid bden pa yin mod kyang*/ theg pa'i bcud kyi snying po 'di dag gi skabs su ni 'og ma'i lta grub la ltos mi 'tshal zhing*/ thams cad dang 493)mthun la thams cad las khyad par du gyur pa zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dgongs pa de gang la zer na/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyi bsdus pa'i chos so cog thams cad la/

bden mi bden/ yod med/ yin min/ skye 'gag 'gro 'ong*/ rtag chad la sogs par gang la'ang mi zhen/ mi 'dzin/ mi dgag mi bsgrub ste/ ci'i phyir na/ gang med par smras na chad pa'i mthar lhung zhing*/ yod par byas na ni rtag pa'i mtha' dang*/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin no snyam du 'dzin na'ang blos byas kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ gzhan snang gi ngor ni/ yod na yod du chug ste 'gags med kyi 'char sgo zad mtha' med cing rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la bslu ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ 494)gang zhig med pa rnams kyi ngor ni med du chug ste/ gshis ngor gang du yang grub pa med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid las ma g.yos pa'i phyir dang*/ yod med gnyis ka ma yin yang bden du chug ste/ mtha' gang du yang ma lhungs shing phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i phyir ro/ de bas na phyi rol snod bcud du snang ba'i dngos po thams cad ni ma dag sems can gyi bag chags las snang 'khrul pa'i ngor ni 'byung lnga gdos bcas a 'thas kyi tshul dang*/ lam pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis ngor ni rang sems 'gags med kyi snang ba/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la ni ye shes rang gsal gyi zhing khams te/ don dam par ni thams cad sems nyid kyi cho rol kho na nyid de bzhin du/ nang gi sems dang*/ sems byung gi rtog tshogs rnams kyang ma dag 'khrul pa'i skye 'gro rnams la ni las nyon 495)bag chags kyi rang bzhin/ lam pa'i rnal 'byor rnams la ni lta sgom nyams rtogs kyi bye brag bde gshegs sku gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams la ni mkhyen brtse ye shes kyi rol ba ste/ des na rgyu'am gzhi'i gnas lugs la ni khyad par rdul rtsam ma mchis na'ang*/ blo bur kun btags kyi sgrib pas cher 'thums pa dang*/ cung zad 'thums pa dang*/ sgrib pa bral ba dang bcas pa'i khyad par gyur phyir/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum ga'i ngo bo sku gnyis zung 'jug gam sku gsum dbyer med nyid las sngar ma 'das/

mi 'da'/ 'da' bar mi 'gyur ba'i don gyi snying po rang sems ma bcos phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du glod pa kho na gnad du che yi/ 'dus ma byas kyi chos la 'dus byas blo'i sgro btags skur 496)'des bya te tshig gi mtha' la zhen cing phyogs re'i grub mtha' la rtsod par byed pa rnams ni/ byis pa'i skye bo dag gis nam mkha' mtha' rgyas rtsod pa dang mtshungs phyir/ bzo med lhug pa'i dang du phyams gdal mnyam nyid chen por zhog mdzod dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi dang*/ sa bcu lam lnga sku gsum lhun grub kyi 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbyings su bgrod bya bgrod byed kyi mtshan ma las 'das pa'i ngang du grol bar gdon mi za ba nyid do/ kye ho/ gdod nas ye grol bde gshegs snying po'i khams// lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba 'jag mig srin bu yan chad la// rtag tu 'bral med bzhugs kyang ma rig sgrib// gdul bya ji snyed 'dul byed chos kyi sgo/ de snyed bstan kyang rang snang ma dag 'khrul// lam nor lam log lam gol lam 497)gyis bcings// yang dag lam bzang bgrod pa u dum war// mtha' ma grub kyang mthar 'dzin sgrog tu chud/ rang la yod kyang mi shes dbul mo'i gter/ ma bcos rang byung bcos ma'i lhad kyis bslad// yin lugs rang tshang mi rig ci zhig nyes// stobs 'byor can rnams bsod nams bdud du 'babs// thos pas dregs kun rgyud rko snum dred khyer// blun sgom 'jur bsgril bye mar snum tshir 'bad// gnas lugs phyag chen su zhig gnad du bzhugs/ khye hud mdo sngags nyi zla zung gi bstan mchog ni// chu lha mor gshegs thun mtshams li khri'i sprin// yal ga'i tshul la mi skyo 'dir snang gi /ched du dal 'byor rdul du gtong 'di ci// mi 498)med ri yi khrod du srog 'tsho'i zas// gyi na tsam la legs brten gtan 'dun mchog /gnyug ma'i rang zhal blta mdzad sgrub rgyud kyi/

lugs de bstan pa min par gzigs sam kyai// bstan pa'i don zhes bstan pa bsnub pa'i las// sgrub brtson yang dag sgrub la mi brtson pa'i// dus 'dir bdag 'dra'i yig sna 'di 'dra'i rigs// su la ci mkho su zhig dang du len// rang la mi dgos gzhan gyis mi mgu ba'i// yig nag dpe yis phug kun brgyangs na yang*// sems rgyud 'ga' yang thul ba'i nus med phyir// snag shog sor mo'i ngal ba tsam du zad// ring mo'i dus nas nan gyis rab bskul bar// mdzad pa gang gi gsung ngo mi ldog phyir// spyi rtol skyes nas smras las don mthun gyi// tshig 499)don skyon bral dgos pa'i mthu yis dben// brjod byed tshig la dbang ba'i rnam dpyod dang*// brjod bya don chen rtogs pa'i nyams myong sogs// gang yang med bzhin smras 'dis mkhas grub rnams// bzhad bgad 'phel ba'i rgyu ru 'gyur las ci// 'on kyang ngan blos ma bsgribs lhag bsam 'od// kunda'i ge sar bzhad pa'i 'phreng mdzes gang*// rang skal mtshungs pa'i sgom chung gsar bu 'ga'i// rna ba'i rgyan 'gyur srid mtha' mi khegs tsam// 'di bris dge dang 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi// zag bcas zag med dge kun gcig sdoms mthus// sgrub rgyud bstan pa phyogs mthar khyab rgyas shing*// 'gro kun phyag rgya che 'bras mngon 'gyur shog/

de ltar nges don phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa po rnams la bogs 'don dang lam rim 500) gyi rtags tshad la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge zhib rgyas zhig bgyis zhes/ sman sgom rig pa 'dzin pa tshul khrims bzang pos ring mo zhig nas yang yang bskul bar mdzad mod kyang*/ de lta bu zab rgyas mtha' yas pa sgrub rgyud gong ma rnams kyi bka' 'bum dag las 'byung phyir slar bris pa'i dgos pa yang ma mchis pa dang*/ khyad par rang nyid la skyabs gnas drin can rnams kyis thugs rjes dgongs te lam zab phyag chen gyi rigs gyur la/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ yi ge bzhi pa/ gaṅga ma/ yi ge med pa/ brda rtsa dang grub snying gi skor/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ye shes gsal byed/ lnga ldan/ yid bzhin nor bu/ gnad kyi gzer drug dmar 'khrid skor mang po sogs gsar ma la grags pa dag dang*/ rnying lugs kyi phyag chen klong yangs mtha' bral nyi ma'i snying po/ rig pa gcig skyes/ ma rig mun sel/ gnyug ma gcer mthong la sogs pa gter byon gyi rigs mang po dang bcas pa sku drin du bstsal ba thob mod kyang*/ rang nyid las nyon dang rnam g.yeng gi rba la 'phyan pas/ de dag gi nyams rtogs kyi 501) cha shas cung zad tsam yang rgyud la ma skyes tshe/ 'di bzhin bkod pa'i nus spobs ma mchis rung*/ bskul ba po'i ngag mi bzlog phyir long 'gros mun tshad lta bur bris pa 'di la/ mkhas grub dpyod ldan rnams kyis mi khrel bar gsol ba snying nas 'debs shing*/ 'di'i dge bas ma rgan mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang dam pa tshe 'dir thob par gyur cig maṅga lam bha wantu/ rgod tshang pa min rgod tshang par/ grags pa'i mi rgan snyams las pas// la stod sgod tshang ma yin pa'i// dpal ri rgod tshang phug tu bris// dge'o//
